column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_cutin_viewer.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Module entry point: registers the cut-in viewer scene with system_scene_register(ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main 0x0000003c, ui_cutin_viewer_scene_end_noop 0x000002e4, 0x00043650) and returns 0. Side effects: scene registration. No direct caller (module entry).

Stub that ignores its arguments and returns 0. Both callers call it as (0x20, 1) at the places where the rel_duel_draw copies call ui_test_set_draw_flags(0x20, 1), so the viewer drops that UI draw flag (medium). No side effects. Callers: 2 (field_3d_cutin_default_on_motion_end, field_3d_cutin_default_frame_events).

Scene start callback and main loop of the cut-in viewer: ui_cutin_viewer_init, registers ui_cutin_viewer_draw_frame / ui_cutin_viewer_frame_leave_noop as the frame callbacks, then each frame (system_wait_frame) dispatches on the state word 0x00043674: 1 scan the cut-in files (ui_cutin_viewer_scan_cutin_files, then state 2), 2 ui_cutin_viewer_update_file_list, 3 ui_cutin_viewer_load_file, 4 ui_cutin_viewer_update_file_preview, 5 leave the loop, 6 ui_cutin_viewer_open_card_view, 7 ui_cutin_viewer_close_card_view, 8 ui_cutin_viewer_update_character_list, 9 ui_cutin_viewer_wait_cutin_archive, 10 ui_cutin_viewer_update_cutin_preview. On exit: ui_cutin_viewer_term, system_scene_set_noop_callbacks, one more frame, system_scene_return(0xb, 0). No return value. Registered as the scene start callback by ui_cutin_viewer_register_scene.

Initialises the viewer: clears the 0x86e0-byte work block at 0x00043670, sets the thread attribute 0x4000 (sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr), creates a heap of 0xb00000 bytes at 0x0004bd50 (system_heap_create; handle in 0x00043670), hands it to the module allocator 0x2d18c and installs the allocator pair 0x2d1b4/0x2d1c4 with field_3d_set_allocator, sets the state 0x00043674 = 6, initialises the 3D render state on layer 0 (field_3d_init_render_state), loads sound bank 0x2ca (audio_load_track) and sets the shown card id 0x0004bd48 to the first valid card id from 0xe88 (card_db_is_valid). No return value. Side effects: the work block, heap, render state, sound bank. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).

Releases what ui_cutin_viewer_init set up: audio_release_track(0x2ca), field_3d_term_render_state, field_3d_set_allocator(0, 0), the module allocator shutdown 0x2d1a0 and system_free_aligned of the heap 0x00043670 (then cleared). No return value. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).
Empty function. No side effects. Registered as the scene end callback by ui_cutin_viewer_register_scene.

State switch of the viewer: runs the leave handler of the current state 0x00043674 (10 ui_cutin_viewer_stop_cutin_preview, 9 ui_cutin_viewer_leave_loading_noop, 8 and 2 ui_cutin_viewer_leave_list_noop, 4 ui_cutin_viewer_leave_file_preview, 3 or 1 system_set_loading_overlay(0)), stores state, then runs the enter handler (10 ui_cutin_viewer_start_cutin_preview, 9 ui_cutin_viewer_request_cutin_archive, 8 ui_cutin_viewer_open_character_list, 4 ui_cutin_viewer_enter_file_preview, 2 ui_cutin_viewer_open_file_list, 3 or 1 system_set_loading_overlay(1)). No return value. Side effects: the state word and those of the handlers. Callers: 11 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main, ui_cutin_viewer_update_file_list, ui_cutin_viewer_load_file, ui_cutin_viewer_update_character_list, ...).

Builds the path container_get_root_path(3) + the folder string at 0x000394f4 (the duel folder), clears the file count 0x00049a78 and calls ui_cutin_viewer_scan_dir_recursive on it. No return value. Side effects: the file list 0x00043678 and its count. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main, state 1).

Clears and fills the 0x120-byte list-window record at 0x00049a7c (geometry and style fields, the heap 0x00043670 at +0xc4, width 0xf0 at +0xf0, item draw callback ui_cutin_viewer_draw_file_item at +0xfc) and opens it with ui_open_list_window, then stores the item count 0x00049a78 at +0xcc. No return value. Side effects: the list window. Callers: 2 (ui_cutin_viewer_set_state on entering state 2, ui_cutin_viewer_open_character_list).
Empty function (leave handler of states 2 and 8). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_set_state; state 8 reaches it through a thunk).

State 2: ui_update_list_window(0x00049a7c); when the window's result byte +0xe9 is 6 (closed), a result of -2 (cancel) switches to state 5 (exit), otherwise stores the chosen file index in 0x00049b9c and switches to state 3. No return value. Side effects: state switch. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).

State 3: waits one frame, reads the chosen file (path 0x00043678 + index x 0x100 under root 3) with container_read_file_from_start into the archive handle 0x00043660 and binds it with container_ehp_bind_with_callback(0, 0x00043660), then switches to state 4. No return value. Side effects: file I/O, archive handle, state. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).

Enter handler of state 4 (raw file preview): ui_cutin_viewer_collect_scene_members, ui_cutin_viewer_create_largest_model, 0x2ae4(model 0x00049d30), builds a zeroed 0x38-byte descriptor with character -1 and copies it into the preview slot 0x00049ba0 (field_3d_cutin_init_slot_from_desc), points slot +0x44 (scene list) at 0x0004ad34, and starts motion 0 (field_3d_cutin_set_motion) or, when no scene was found (0x0004bd34 = 0), returns to state 2. No return value. Side effects: preview slot, model instance, state. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_set_state).

Leave handler of state 4: destroys the preview model 0x00049d30 (field_3d_destroy_model_instance), clears the archive handle 0x00043660 (10 bytes), the 400-byte preview slot 0x00049ba0 and the first words of both member lists, and calls 0x2ae4(0). No return value. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_set_state).

State 4 loop (runs its own frames): restarts motion 0 of the preview slot 0x00049ba0, then each frame reads the pad (system_pad_get_state); repeat bits +0xc 0x80 / 0x20 (left / right) step the scene index 0x0004bd38 with wrap over the count 0x0004bd34 and restart field_3d_cutin_set_motion on it; the cross button (+4 bit 0x4000) leaves to state 2. No return value. Side effects: index, slot motion, state. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).

State 6 (the first state): starts the card-resource loader (0x2bba0, 0x2c174), waits for the card CIP reader (card_db_cip_is_ready) and for archive 0x80001 (0x2bfb0), fills a 0x24-byte parameter block with members of that archive (0x2bf28, 0x2be5c(0x20001)) and the CIP reader, opens it with ui_card_view_open and switches to state 8. No return value. Side effects: resource loads, the card view, state. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).
State 7: ui_card_view_close, releases the card resources (0x2bc24) and switches to state 5 (exit). No return value. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).

Enter handler of state 8: opens the list window through ui_cutin_viewer_open_file_list, then sets 0x8d items (+0xcc), the item draw callback ui_cutin_viewer_draw_character_item (+0xfc) and restores the scroll and cursor from the last chosen item 0x0004bd3c; turns the loading overlay off. No return value. Side effects: list window, overlay. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_set_state).

Jump thunk (8 bytes: j 0x00000670; nop) to ui_cutin_viewer_leave_list_noop. Arguments, return value and side effects are those of ui_cutin_viewer_leave_list_noop (documented in docs/subsystems/functions/ui.md). Callers: 1 (FUN_000002ec).

column2: void ui_cutin_viewer_draw_character_item(void *list_ptr, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: List item callback of the character list: gets the name string of character item + 2 (world_get_character_name_string_first(0, ...), fallback string 0x00039510), formats number and name with system_swprintf (format 0x000394fc), and draws it at (x + 2, y + 2) with scale 12, colour 0xff000000 into list_ptr (system_font_begin/end_external_list). No return value. Side effects: display-list commands. No direct caller (reached through the list window callback).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT.BIN ui_list_window_draw_text: draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge, system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text) (the decompiler shows only the argument set-up of the tail call). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_cutin_viewer_draw_character_item, ui_cutin_viewer_draw_file_item).

State 8: reads the pad and updates the list window 0x00049a7c; pressed left / right (+4 bits 0x80 / 0x20) cycle the variant 0x0004bd44 through 0..3, up / down (0x50) reset it to 0; when the window closes (+0xe9 = 6) a result of -2 goes to state 7, otherwise character 0x0004bd40 = item + 2, the item is kept in 0x0004bd3c and the state becomes 9. No return value. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).

Enter handler of state 9: loading overlay on, then 0x2c38c(&character 0x0004bd40, &variant 0x0004bd44, 1) and 0x2c590 (requests the character's cut-in archive; hypothesis, confidence medium). No return value. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_set_state).
Empty function (leave handler of state 9). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_set_state).
State 9: switches to state 10 once archives 0x80001 and 0x80002 are ready (0x2bfb0) and 0x2c750 returns non-zero. No return value. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).

Enter handler of state 10: gets the cut-in archive of (character 0x0004bd40, variant 0x0004bd44) with 0x2c8f8, copies its all-ptrs.txt member (0x2b4 words, 0xad0 bytes) into 0x00049d34 and sets the count 0x0004bd34 = 0x2b4; when a non-empty entry exists (first one into 0x0004bd38) it calls field_3d_cutin_init_system, 0x10518, field_3d_cutin_setup_slot(0, character, variant), field_3d_cutin_select_slot(0), field_3d_cutin_set_card_id(0x0004bd48) and field_3d_cutin_reset_current(index + 0x1000) (a direct animation index); otherwise (or with no archive) it returns to state 8. No return value. Side effects: the cut-in system, state. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_set_state).
Leave handler of state 10: 0x105ac (counterpart of the 0x10518 set-up) then field_3d_cutin_term_system. No return value. Side effects: frees the cut-in slots. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_set_state).

State 10 loop (runs its own frames): repeat left / right (+0xc bits 0x80 / 0x20) step the animation index 0x0004bd38 to the previous / next non-empty all-ptrs entry (wrap); pressed circle (+4 bit 0x2000) only marks a change; on any change the shown card id 0x0004bd48 advances to the next valid id (card_db_is_valid, wrapping from 0x1f39 to 0xe88), then field_3d_cutin_set_card_id and field_3d_cutin_reset_current(index + 0x1000); the cross button (0x4000) returns to state 8. No return value. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main).

Per-frame draw callback: state 10 sets the depth range (60000, 100) on layer 0, then field_3d_cutin_dispatch_motion_start, field_3d_draw_cutin_layer, field_3d_cutin_run_frame_hook_current, 0x10618, and steps 0x106c0 and field_3d_update_current_cutin with dt = 1 / (frame-timing word +4); state 4 draws the preview slot 0x00049ba0 on layer 1 (field_3d_cutin_draw) and updates it (field_3d_update_cutin); states 8 and 2 draw the list window on layer 1; state 1 and the others print a status string (0x00039538 / 0x0003952c) with system_font_printf. The member-name look-ups at the start have no used result. No return value. Side effects: display lists, cut-in updates. Registered as the frame callback by ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main.
Empty function. No side effects. Registered as the second frame callback by ui_cutin_viewer_scene_main.

Lists directory path with sceIoDopen/sceIoDread/sceIoDclose: sub-directories (mode bit 0x1000, name not starting with '.') are appended to path with a separator and scanned recursively; regular files (mode bit 0x2000) are stored as path relative to root 3 + name in slot 0x00043678 + n x 0x100 and kept (n = 0x00049a78 incremented) when ui_cutin_viewer_is_cutin_file accepts them; stops at 100 files. No return value. Side effects: the file list and count; path is restored after each recursion. Callers: 2 (ui_cutin_viewer_scan_cutin_files, itself).

column2: void ui_cutin_viewer_draw_file_item(void *list_ptr, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: List item callback of the file list: widens the path 0x00043678 + item x 0x100 to UTF-16 and draws it at (x + 2, y + 2), scale 12, colour 0xff000000 (ui_list_window_draw_text inside system_font_begin/end_external_list). No return value. No direct caller (reached through the list window callback).

True when the file name after the last '/' starts with the 6-character prefix string at 0x00039558 (cutin_) and is not the string at 0x00039560 (cutin_cmn.ehp). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_scan_dir_recursive).

Walks the members of the loaded archive 0x00043660 (container_ehp_get_member_by_index); for every name ending in the 11-character suffix 0x00039570 (the -etc scene TGMT, .tmt.gz) stores the member in the scene list 0x0004ad34[n], replaces the suffix by 0x0003957c (.tmt.gz) and stores that member (container_ehp_find_member) in the animation list 0x00049d34[n]; n ends in 0x0004bd34 and both lists are zero-terminated. No return value. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_enter_file_preview).

Among the members of archive 0x00043660 whose name ends in the 4-character suffix 0x00039584 (the mesh extension; hypothesis .tms, confidence medium) picks the largest and creates a model instance from it with the animation list 0x00049d34 (field_3d_create_model_instance), stored in 0x00049d30. No return value. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_enter_file_preview).

Sorts the three cut-in voice tables of this module with system_qsort and the compare function 0x0002d3d4 (first word as key; copy of ui_compare_first_word) so they can be binary-searched: the voice sequence table 0x0003958c (0x266 entries of 0x24 bytes), the standard event table 0x0003ebe4 (0x20 entries of 12 bytes) and the generic-student event table 0x0003ed64 (0x1f entries of 12 bytes). No return value. Side effects: reorders those tables. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_init_system).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_term_system).

Binary-searches the cut-in voice sequence table 0x0003958c (0x266 entries of 0x24 bytes, compare function 0x0002d3d4) for key with system_bsearch and returns the entry or null. No side effects. Callers: 1 (audio_step_cutin_voice_sequence).

column2: void audio_step_cutin_voice_sequence(void *cutin, int key, int unused, int event, int advance)
column3: Advances the voice lines of a cut-in: finds the sequence entry of key (audio_find_cutin_voice_sequence; 0x24-byte entries: key word then per step a pair whose second word is the step's trigger event, -9999 = any) or uses the default at 0x0003eedc; does nothing while a skip is requested (field_3d_cutin_is_skip_requested). Clears the playing flag +0xb4 once the side's voice queue (cutin +0x38) is empty (audio_get_queued_voice_sound_id). When advance is non-zero and the next step (+0xac + 1, below 4) has queued cues (row +0x6c + step x 0x10 not negative) and its trigger equals event or is -9999, makes it current, clears +0xb0, queues up to 4 voice ids of that row with audio_queue_duellist_voice(side, voice, 0) and sets +0xb4 = 1. No return value. Side effects: cut-in fields, the duellist voice queue. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_default_frame_hook).

Resets the voice queue of a cut-in slot: word +0xb4 (playing flag) = 0, +0xac = -1, +0xb0 = 0, and fills the 0x40 bytes at +0x6c with 0xff. No return value. Side effects: writes those fields. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_reset_current).
Returns whether word +0xb4 of the cut-in slot (its voice playing flag) is non-zero. No side effects. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_is_voice_active).

Initialises the cut-in system: clears the 0x660-byte block 0x00b4bd50 (+0x08 current slot pointer 0x00b4bd58, +0x0c current index 0x00b4bd5c, +0x10 skip flag 0x00b4bd60, then four 0x190-byte slots at 0x00b4bd70), sets the current index to -1, then the subtitle init 0xd98c (copy of ui_init_cutin_subtitle) and audio_sort_cutin_voice_tables. No return value. Side effects: the cut-in block, subtitle and voice-table state. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_start_cutin_preview).

Shuts the cut-in system down: audio_stub_noop_cutin_voice_term, the subtitle term 0xd9a0, field_3d_cutin_release_slot(slot, 1) on the four slots 0x00b4bd70 + i x 0x190, then clears the 0x660-byte block 0x00b4bd50 and sets the current index 0x00b4bd5c to -1. No return value. Side effects: frees the slots' model instances and buffers, the cut-in block. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_stop_cutin_preview).

If the current cut-in slot (0x00b4bd58) has its start-pending flag +0x5c set, clears it and calls field_3d_cutin_call_on_motion_start(slot, motion index +0x50, 0). No return value. Side effects: slot +0x5c and the on-motion-start callback's effects. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_draw_frame).

Draws the cut-in presentation: selects display-list layer 8, draws the speed lines (ui_draw_cutin_speed_lines), pushes the three GUM matrix stacks, draws the current slot 0x00b4bd58 (field_3d_cutin_draw), sets a perspective with the current fov/aspect/near and far 10000.0, updates the matrices, saves them (0x11b80, copy of field_3d_save_matrix_state), commits the layer, pops the stacks, and finally updates the matrices into layer 9. No return value. Side effects: GE layers 8 and 9, the GUM matrix state. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_draw_frame).
Calls field_3d_cutin_run_frame_hook with the current cut-in slot [0x00b4bd58]. No return value. Side effects: those of field_3d_cutin_run_frame_hook. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_draw_frame).
Calls field_3d_update_cutin(dt, current slot 0x00b4bd58) and returns 0 (dt stays in f12 from the caller). Side effects: those of field_3d_update_cutin. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_draw_frame).

column2: void field_3d_cutin_setup_slot(int slot, int character, int variant)
column3: Prepares cut-in slot slot (0x00b4bd70 + slot x 0x190) for a character: builds a 0x38-byte descriptor with field_3d_cutin_init_default_desc, lets the per-character set-up routine returned by field_3d_cutin_get_chara_setup patch it, copies it into the slot (field_3d_cutin_init_slot_from_desc), loads the assets now (field_3d_cutin_load_slot_assets) unless character is 1 or system_get_net_active_flag is set, and stores slot in +0x38. No return value. Side effects: the slot record, archive look-ups and model creation. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_start_cutin_preview).

Makes slot the current cut-in when it is not already: resets the current one (field_3d_cutin_reset_current(-1)), stores the slot pointer in 0x00b4bd58 and the index in 0x00b4bd5c, loads its assets when its loaded flag +0x3c is 0 (field_3d_cutin_load_slot_assets) and resets again. No return value. Side effects: 0x00b4bd58/0x00b4bd5c, the slot. Callers: 1 (ui_cutin_viewer_start_cutin_preview).

Stores card_id (0 becomes -1) at +0x160 of the current cut-in slot [0x00b4bd58]. No return value. Side effects: writes slot +0x160. Callers: 2 (ui_cutin_viewer_start_cutin_preview, ui_cutin_viewer_update_cutin_preview).

With a current slot (0x00b4bd58): closes the LP panel (0xe100), stores 0x2000b with field_3d_cutin_set_word_098d53a8, points the speed lines at the slot's character/variant (ui_set_speed_lines_source), fades them (ui_fade_speed_lines(0xff, 1)), sets the motion (field_3d_cutin_set_motion(slot, motion); -1 stops it) and resets the slot's voice queue (audio_reset_cutin_voice_queue). Returns 1. Side effects: UI panels, speed lines, the slot's motion state, the voice queue. Callers: 3 (ui_cutin_viewer_start_cutin_preview, ui_cutin_viewer_update_cutin_preview, field_3d_cutin_select_slot).
Tail-calls field_3d_cutin_get_node_matrix(current slot 0x00b4bd58, out, node). No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 2 (0x000120b8, 0x000120f8).
Tail-calls field_3d_cutin_get_attach_matrix(current slot 0x00b4bd58, out, attach_id). No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 7 (0x00012190, 0x0001dc14, 0x0001e908, 0x00021570, ...).
Returns the projection matrix of the current cut-in slot: [0x00b4bd58] + 0xd0. No side effects. Callers: 3 (0x00011940, 0x00011c80, 0x00024b60).
Returns the view matrix of the current cut-in slot: [0x00b4bd58] + 0x110. No side effects. Callers: 4 (0x00011814, 0x00011940, 0x00011c80, 0x00024b60).
Returns the eye position of the current cut-in slot: [0x00b4bd58] + 0x150. No side effects. Callers: 2 (0x0001e908, 0x00021570).
Returns the cut-in skip-request flag 0x00b4bd60 (block +0x10). No side effects. Callers: 1 (audio_step_cutin_voice_sequence).
Stores flag at +0x168 of the current cut-in slot [0x00b4bd58] through field_3d_cutin_set_disc_flag. No return value. Side effects: writes slot +0x168. Callers: 2 (0x00024140, 0x0002462c).
Returns the word at +0x168 of the current cut-in slot [0x00b4bd58] (set by field_3d_cutin_set_disc_flag). No side effects. Callers: 1 (0x00027584).

Returns the per-character cut-in descriptor set-up routine (it patches the default descriptor's callbacks and tables). A chain of tests on character (and for characters 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0x14, 0x24 and 0x29 on variant) picks one of about 40 routines, e.g. 0x0002d3e4 for characters 9..0x12, 0x2b..0x2d and 0x96..0x98, 0x00003bd8 for 0x28, 0x00008824 for 0x90 (and 0x14 variant 2). Characters 0x7f, 0x91, 0x92, 0x93 and any unknown id fall back on the generic player models: world_get_character_model_ids(character, 0) and world_get_character_byte_09 choose 0x00007e88 (byte 9 = 5), 0x00006f88 (model id byte 1 = 3) or 0x00005bb8 (otherwise). No side effects. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_setup_slot).

Draws the cut-in speed-lines layout: when a source pair is set (0x00b4c3b0/0x00b4c3b4) it gets the cut-in archive with 0x2c8f8 (copy of field_3d_get_cutin_archive) and finds the member named by the pointer 0x0003ef0c (ryusen01.ehf), then plays it with a 0x60-byte draw-parameter block (frame-timing word, flag bit 2, scale 0x100 on three axes, level word from the current level 0x00b4c3bc) between ui_ehf_begin_draw and ui_ehf_end_draw. It then advances the 10-frame fade counter 0x00b4c3c8, interpolates 0x00b4c3bc linearly from the start level 0x00b4c3c0 to the target 0x00b4c3c4, and appends a depth clear (system_ge_set_clear_depth 0, system_ge_write_clear 0x14). Returns the advanced display-list pointer, or list unchanged when nothing was drawn. Side effects: GE commands; writes 0x00b4c3bc and 0x00b4c3c8. Callers: 1 (field_3d_draw_cutin_layer).
Stores value in the word 0x00b4c3b8 (the copy of rel_duel_draw's word 0x098d53a8, block +0x668). No return value. Side effects: writes 0x00b4c3b8. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_reset_current).

Stores character in 0x00b4c3b0 and variant in 0x00b4c3b4 (the speed-lines source pair used by ui_draw_cutin_speed_lines to find the archive). No return value. Side effects: writes those two words. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_reset_current).

Sets the speed-lines target level 0x00b4c3c4 to level. When immediate is 0 the current level 0x00b4c3bc becomes the start level 0x00b4c3c0 and the fade counter 0x00b4c3c8 is reset, so ui_draw_cutin_speed_lines fades to the target over 10 frames; otherwise current, start and target all become level at once. No return value. Side effects: writes 0x00b4c3bc, 0x00b4c3c0, 0x00b4c3c4 and, in the fade case, 0x00b4c3c8. Callers: 2 (field_3d_cutin_reset_current, 0x000123f4).

Clears a 0x190-byte cut-in slot and copies the 0x38-byte descriptor into its first words (field_3d_cutin_copy_desc). No return value. Side effects: writes the slot. Callers: 2 (field_3d_cutin_setup_slot, ui_cutin_viewer_enter_file_preview).
Copies 14 words (0x38 bytes, a cut-in descriptor). Returns dst. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_init_slot_from_desc).

Character 0xc: variant 0 -> 0/0/0; animation 0x1da-0x222 -> 0x55/-1/1; 0x199-0x1d9 and 0x223-0x2b3 -> 0/0x1e/0; any other id -> 0/-1/0. Character 0x29: same ranges but variant != 0 -> 0/0/0 and start 0x78 for 0x1da-0x222. Any other character: 1/1/0. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_extra_a_fx).

column2: int field_3d_create_cutin_extra_a_fx(void *fx_slot, int task_arg_a, int task_arg_b)
column3: Creates the draw task field_3d_update_cutin_extra_a_fx with ui_duel_create_draw_task(callback, task_arg_a, task_arg_b, 0x210 bytes) and stores fx_slot (cut-in effect slot, table 0x00b4eaac) at task data +0x18. Returns the task handle, or -1 when no task entry was free. Side effects: allocates a task entry and its data. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_extra_fx).

column2: void * field_3d_draw_cutin_extra_a_screen_quad(void *list, float *position, int alpha, uint *rgb, float *corners, float *camera_rotation, float *view_projection)
column3: Draws one glow sprite of field_3d_update_cutin_extra_a_fx in screen space: sets the colour from rgb[0..2] (red, green, blue words) and alpha; builds translate(position) x camera_rotation on the GUM stack, reads it back (system_vfpu_matrix300_store_q) and multiplies it by view_projection; transforms the two corner points corners[0] and corners[1] (vec4 each), projects them to screen (x 240/w + 2048, -y 136/w + 2048), returns without drawing when a point falls outside 0..0x1000, otherwise subtracts the screen offset (0x710, 0x778) and draws a sprite spanning the two points (system_ge_set_sprite_extent with a 16 x 16 source, system_ge_draw_sprite_flipped at texture coordinates (0x28, 8)) when it has positive width and height. Returns the advanced display list. sceVfpu matrix calls read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_extra_a_fx).

Draw-task callback of the per-character extra cut-in effect A: a flickering glow traced along the bones of the duelist model in the main scene. Task data: +0 wait counter, +4 start frame, +8 elapsed, +0xc length (-1 = endless), +0x10 fade-in flag (all from field_3d_get_cutin_fx_timing_extra_by_character), +0x14 frame counter, +0x18 fx slot, +0x1c/+0x20/+0x24 colour and +0x28 fx texture (character 2 variant 2: 0x7f, 0, 0x7f, texture 0xd; character 0x2b: 0xff, 0x7f, 0, 0xf; character 0xc: 0x9b, 0xc8, 0xff, 0xd; others 0xff, 0xc8, 0x9b, 0xf), +0x30..+0x6c five corner pairs (half sizes 7/12/17/60/65 for characters 2 and 0x2b, else 5/10/15/20/25), +0xd0.. random phases. Once started it reads node positions of the main scene model (field_3d_get_main_scene_node_position with node lists at 0x00041330, 0x00041360, 0x00041370, 0x00041378, 0x00041388), interpolates points along the segments between them (system_vfpu_vector3_lerp) and draws a glow sprite at each with field_3d_draw_cutin_extra_a_screen_quad, alpha 150 (or 255 for some) x fade-in over 8 frames (when the flag is set) x fade-out over the last 16 frames (when the length is not -1), flickering with sin(phase + k x frame counter); the camera is the cut-in's projection x view matrix. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. With length -1 it always returns 2 (it runs until removed); otherwise 2 while elapsed < length, else 4; counters advance only while the slot's run flag (+4) is 1. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data. No direct caller (draw-task callback registered by field_3d_create_cutin_extra_a_fx through ui_duel_create_draw_task).

column2: int field_3d_create_cutin_extra_c_fx(void *fx_slot, int task_arg_a, int task_arg_b)
column3: Creates the draw task field_3d_update_cutin_extra_c_fx with ui_duel_create_draw_task(callback, task_arg_a, task_arg_b, 0xfc bytes) and stores fx_slot (cut-in effect slot, table 0x00b4eaac) at task data +8. Returns the task handle, or -1 when no task entry was free. Side effects: allocates a task entry and its data. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_extra_fx).

Draw-task callback of the per-character extra cut-in effect C, a fixed 0x3c-frame effect. Task data: +0 elapsed, +4 frame counter, +8 fx slot, +0xc two copies of a 4-vertex full-screen quad (through-mode vertices: colour, 16-bit x, y, z; vertex type 0x80011c) chosen by frame parity, +0x6c a 20 x 20 flash fan. Pushes the main camera matrices; reads two node positions of the main scene model (node ids at 0x00041394, field_3d_get_main_scene_node_position), offset by -1/+1 in x and a constant in y. Draws the full-screen quad untextured with a subtractive-style blend, three corners white with alpha 255 x ui_duel_get_fade_out_ratio(elapsed, 0x28, 0x3c) and the fourth with 255 x inverse progress over 0x28 frames; then the fan (centre 0xc8ff00ff, rim 0x00ff00ff, fx texture 3) camera-facing at both node positions, alpha = sine ease over 0x14 frames x ui_duel_ease_cosine_tail(elapsed, 0x28, 0x3c). That the two nodes are the eyes is a hypothesis (confidence low). Returns 2 while elapsed < 0x3c, else 4; elapsed advances only while the slot's run flag (+4) is 1. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data. No direct caller (draw-task callback registered by field_3d_create_cutin_extra_c_fx through ui_duel_create_draw_task).
Timing of the cut-in effect for animation id 0xe7: start frame 0x53 and length 0xe6; any other id gets 1/1. Side effects: writes the two outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_fx_anime7).

Stores the list of cards shown by the animation-0xe7 cut-in effect: count clamped to 0x28 at 0x00b4eb20 and the card ids copied to 0x00b4eb24 (up to 40 words). Side effects: writes 0x00b4eb20 and the id array at 0x00b4eb24. Callers: 1 (0x00004d90).

column2: int field_3d_create_cutin_fx_anime7(void *fx_slot, int task_arg_a, int task_arg_b)
column3: Creates the draw task field_3d_update_cutin_fx_anime7 with ui_duel_create_draw_task(callback, task_arg_a, task_arg_b, 0x670 bytes) and stores fx_slot (cut-in effect slot, table 0x00b4eaac) at task data +0x18. Returns the task handle, or -1 when no task entry was free. Side effects: allocates a task entry and its data. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_fx).

column2: void * field_3d_draw_cutin_fx_card_quads(void *list, int card_id, int alpha, float *position, float *angles, void *front_quad, void *back_quad)
column3: Draws one two-sided card: sets the ambient alpha, pushes the matrix, translates to position, rotates by the XYZ angles, binds the face of card_id (field_3d_dl_bind_card_face_texture(list, card_id, 1)) and draws front_quad (4-vertex strip, vertex type 0x183), binds the card back (card id -1) and draws back_quad, then pops the matrix. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_fx_anime7).

Draw-task callback of the cut-in effect for animation id 0xe7: cards of the list at 0x00b4eb20/0x00b4eb24 (field_3d_set_cutin_fx_card_list) burst out of the character. Task data: +0..+0xc wait/start/elapsed/length (field_3d_get_cutin_fx_timing_anime7), +0x10 frame counter, +0x14 hover counter, +0x18 fx slot, +0x1c sound bits, +0x20 origin-captured flag, +0x24 origin (main scene node 0x17, captured at the start frame), +0x30 front and +0x80 back card quads, +0xd0 one 0x24-byte record per card (direction x/y/z, start angles, spin). Does nothing while the list is empty. Plays sound 0x7a3d at the start frame. First call: gives every card a distinct random radius 15..30 and height -1..1 (random permutations), a direction spread over an arc (fewer than 4 cards) or the full circle, and random start angles and spins. Once started: t = sine ease over 4 frames + k x hover counter; each card moves to origin + direction x t with a parabolic drop (-70 x (t^2/2 - 0.5), clamped at 0) and rotates by start + t x spin, drawn two-sided with field_3d_draw_cutin_fx_card_quads (clip planes off, culling on, depth writes off), followed by 3 fading trail copies at earlier t (alpha 96 x (3 - k)/3). Global alpha = ui_duel_get_fade_out_ratio(elapsed, 8, length). Returns 2 while elapsed < length, else 4; counters advance only while the slot's run flag (+4) is 1. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data, a sound effect. No direct caller (draw-task callback registered by field_3d_create_cutin_fx_anime7 through ui_duel_create_draw_task).

Timing of the per-character extra cut-in effect B, read from the fx slot's character (+8), variant (+0xc) and animation id (+0x10): character 9: 0xbb -> start 0x1c, 0xba -> 0x23; character 2 variant 0: 0x136 -> 0x65, 0xbb -> 0x1d, 0xba -> 0x25, 0xa2 -> 10; length 0x20 in those cases; other ids of characters 9 and 2/0 -> 1/1. For any other character *out_start is left unchanged and *out_length is set to 0x20. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_extra_b_fx).

column2: int field_3d_create_cutin_extra_b_fx(void *fx_slot, int task_arg_a, int task_arg_b)
column3: Creates the draw task field_3d_update_cutin_extra_b_fx with ui_duel_create_draw_task(callback, task_arg_a, task_arg_b, 0x154 bytes) and stores fx_slot (cut-in effect slot, table 0x00b4eaac) at task data +0x14. Returns the task handle, or -1 when no task entry was free. Side effects: allocates a task entry and its data. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_extra_fx).

Draw-task callback of the per-character extra cut-in effect B (two glints on the duelist model in the main scene). Task data: +0..+0xc wait/start/elapsed/length (field_3d_get_cutin_fx_timing_animba_bb), +0x10 frame counter, +0x14 fx slot, +0x18 sound bits, +0x1c and +0x28 two local offsets chosen by character/variant/animation (character 9 ids 0xba/0xbb; character 2 variant 0 ids 0xa2, 0xba, 0xbb, 0x136; zero otherwise), +0x34 and +0xc4 two 20 x 20 flash fans (colours 0xff/0x800000ff, or 0x7f7f00/0x7fff with other centres for character 2). Pushes the main camera matrices; each frame transforms the two offsets by two main-scene nodes (node ids at 0x0004139c, field_3d_transform_point_by_main_scene_node); plays sound 0x7a45 at the start frame; once started draws both fans camera-facing at those points with fx texture 3, alpha = sine ease over 4 frames x ui_duel_ease_cosine_tail(elapsed, 0x18, length). Returns 2 while elapsed < length, else 4; counters advance only while the slot's run flag (+4) is 1. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data, a sound effect. No direct caller (draw-task callback registered by field_3d_create_cutin_extra_b_fx through ui_duel_create_draw_task).

Animation-cue callback that draws the pulsing duel-disk light of the cut-in character (hypothesis for the disk, confidence medium: it follows the cut-in disc flag). Task data: +0 counter, +4 frame counter, +0x10 attach matrix (attach point 0x2b, every frame), +0x50 brightness (first call: 1.0 unless the slot's animation id is in 0x1da-0x222 or is 0x1c1, 0x228, 0x238, 0x24a, 0x24e, 0x264, 0x296; id 0x1f1 forces 1.0), +0x54 enabled flag and +0x58 height (character 0x11: on, 0.5; characters 0xf, 0x10, 0x12, 0x19, 0x21, 0x25, 0x26, 0x28, 0x2c: off; others on, -0.25), +0x5c and +0x17c two 17-vertex fans of radius 5 x size (size scaled for characters 0x2b, 2 with variant 2, 0xe and 0x13): a cyan one (0xffffff00 centre) and a red one (0xff0000ff centre). When enabled it draws both fans untextured and depth-tested in the attach frame with alpha = brightness x (k1 + k2 x sin(k x frame counter)) x 255, then sets the brightness for the next frame to 1.0 when field_3d_cutin_get_current_disc_flag() is 1, else 0. Always returns 2 (keeps running). Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data. Callers: 1 (ui_tick_anim_cue_task).

Animation-cue callback that flashes a flame burst at an attach point of the cut-in character. First call: attach point 0x2e for animation id 0x81, 0x2d for ids 0xc4-0xd4 and 0x104-0x114 (except 0xce, 0xcf, 0x10e, 0x10f), none (-1) otherwise; with none it does nothing. It waits until the cut-in's group-mask bit 8 (attach 0x2e) or bit 9 or 10 is clear (field_3d_cutin_is_mask_bit_clear on the slot's cut-in +0x14), then sets +0x50 and from then on each frame: plays sound 0x7a19 at counter 0, takes the attach matrix offset by the vector 0x000413b0, and draws with fx texture 3 a 30-unit fan (centre 0xff00aaff) spinning about Y and 24 small flame quads on 6 x 4 spinning rings, alpha = (0.5 + 0.5 x progress over 4 frames) x cosine ease over 16 frames; the counter (+0) stops at 16. Always returns 2. Side effects: GE commands on layer 8, the task data, a sound effect. Callers: 1 (ui_tick_anim_cue_task).

Timing table of the cut-in effect for animation ids 0x1da-0x21e: sets *out_length to 0x18 and *out_sound_frame from a per-id list (for example 0x1da -> 0x59, 0x1e3 -> 0x6c, 0x206 -> 0x1c2, 0x21e -> 0x69), with *out_start = sound frame + 8; exceptions 0x1f5 (0xb9, start 0xbe) and 0x1df (sound -1, start 0xa7). Ids without an entry give 0/1/1. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_fx_anim1e3_21e).

column2: void field_3d_get_cutin_sound_fx_timing(int anim_id, int *out_sound_frame, int *out_start, int *out_length)
column3: Timing table of the sound-only cut-in task (field_3d_update_cutin_sound_fx) for animation ids 0x199-0x2b3: sets *out_length to 1, *out_sound_frame from a per-id list (mostly 7, 8, 0xc, 0xe; for example 0x1a3 -> 8, 0x27e -> 0x29) and *out_start = sound frame + 8. Some ids have no sound (-1) and an explicit start: 0x19e -> 0xb, 0x1aa -> 0x1e, 0x1b2 and 0x295 -> 10, 0x1c0 -> 1, 0x23e -> 0xe, 0x24d and 0x29b -> 0, 0x270 and 0x280 -> 0x1c, 0x286 -> 5. Ids 0x1bf, 0x24c and 0x294 write a start value that the final 'start = sound frame + 8' then overwrites, leaving the sound frame at its previous value (0 in a freshly created task). Ids without an entry give 0/1/1. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (field_3d_update_cutin_sound_fx).

column2: void audio_play_anim_sound_cues(int character, int variant, int anim, int frame, uint *done_flags)
column3: Hard-coded sound cues of the duel cut-in/character animations: a long if-chain on the animation id anim (values from 0 to about 0x2a9) that calls audio_play_se_once_at_frame(sound, frame, trigger frame, done_flags, bit) for one to three sound effects per animation, with bits 1, 2, 4 (once 8) so each fires once; the sounds are mostly ids 0x7a24, 0x7a25, 0x7a26 and 0x7a2e, plus 0x7a17, 0x7a1a, 0x7a21, 0x7a27, 0x7a2a, 0x7a2c and 0x7a47. The first argument is read as a character id (hypothesis, confidence medium). A few animations depend on it (e.g. 8, 0x0e, 0x15, 0x1b, 0x21, 0x26-0x2a) or on character 4 with variant 1; some ids (0x294, 0x296, 0x24e, 0x1c1, 0x205, 0x206, 0x1dd, 0x4f, 0x50) have no sound. No return value. Side effects: sounds started, *done_flags. Callers: 1 (ui_tick_anim_cue_task).

column2: int ui_start_anim_cue_task(int cue_def, void *destructor, int destructor_arg)
column3: Creates a draw task (ui_duel_create_draw_task) with tick ui_tick_anim_cue_task, the given destructor and argument and a 0x430-byte data block, and stores cue_def (an animation/cue definition pointer) at data +0x08. Returns the task handle or -1. Side effects: a draw-task slot and its data block. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_aux_fx).

Draw-task tick of the animation-cue task: with def = data[2], draws the cut-in auxiliary effect (field_3d_draw_cutin_aux_fx(state, data + 4, def)), updates the attach flash (field_3d_update_cutin_attach_flash(state, data + 0xac, def)), plays the sound cues of the animation (audio_play_anim_sound_cues(def +0x08, def +0x0c, def +0x10, frame data[0], data + 3)), increments the tick counter data[1] and, when def +0x04 is 1, the frame data[0]. Returns 2 (keep running). Side effects: data[0], data[1], drawing and sounds. No direct caller (tick callback installed by ui_start_anim_cue_task).

Sets the timing used by field_3d_cutin_aux_fx_layer_hook: delay_frames at 0x00b4eb10 and fade_frames at 0x00b4eb18, and clears the delay counter 0x00b4eb0c, the fade counter 0x00b4eb14 and the sound bits 0x00b4eb1c. Side effects: writes those five globals. Callers: 1 (field_3d_start_cutin_aux_fx).

column2: int field_3d_cutin_aux_fx_layer_hook(void **list_ref, int arg1, int layer, int arg3, int after)
column3: Model draw hook installed by field_3d_start_cutin_aux_fx (character 0x19 with animation ids 0xce, 0xcf, 0xee, 0xef) that fades in model layer 0xb; any other layer returns 0 untouched. Before drawing (after == 0): enables lighting (GE state 10), disables lights 0-3 (states 11-14), sets the ambient colour to white with alpha = progress(fade counter 0x00b4eb14, fade length 0x00b4eb18) x 255 and enables blending, and plays sound 0x7a17 once when the delay counter 0x00b4eb0c reaches the delay 0x00b4eb10. After drawing (after != 0): disables lighting, ambient opaque white, blending off, then advances the delay counter up to its limit and afterwards the fade counter up to its limit. Writes the advanced display list back to *list_ref. Returns 1 for layer 0xb. arg1 and arg3 are not used. Side effects: GE commands, the counters, a sound effect. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer: the model draw hook).

Saves the current GUM view matrix (matrix mode 1) into slot index of the saved view matrices at 0x00b4ebd0 + index x 0x40 (system_vfpu_matrix300_store_q), restoring the previous matrix mode afterwards. Side effects: writes one 0x40-byte matrix. Callers: 1 (field_3d_cutin_apply_camera).

Sorts by id (qsort, comparator 0x0002c974) the four duel resource tables: models 0x0004179c (0x28 records of 0x18 bytes), archives 0x00041c0c (4 of 0xcc), textures 0x000421bc (0x23 of 0x10) and layouts 0x0004251c (0xd of 0x14), so ui_find_resource_entry can binary-search them. Side effects: reorders the tables. Callers: 1 (0x00000994).

Releases the duel presentation resources: ui_release_duel_resources, ui_destroy_card_art_readers, field_3d_release_cutin_slots, field_3d_destroy_duel_object_models, then waits frame by frame until the file thread is idle (container_is_file_thread_busy). Side effects: those of the callees. Callers: 1 (0x00000a9c).

Destroys every cached model instance of the duel object table 0x0004179c (40 entries of 0x18 bytes, instance at +0x14) with field_3d_destroy_model_instance and clears the pointers; then for each of the two backdrop archive slots at 0x00d420b0 that is in use (+8) clears it, or marks it release-pending (+0x14 = 1) when its +0x10 flag is set. Side effects: frees model instances, writes the table and the archive slots. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_release_all).

Clears the caches of the duel resource tables: destroys the model instances of the 0x28 model records (+0x14 at 0x000417b0) and clears them; frees the buffers of the 4 archive records (+0xc4 at 0x00041cd0) to the module heap (system_duel_draw_heap_alloc/free copies 0x0002d1b4/0x0002d1c4); for the 0x23 texture records frees the cached data (+0xc) when the archive id +4 is -1 (stand-alone file) and clears the cache in every case; clears the cache (+0x10) of the 0xd layout records. Side effects: writes the tables, heap blocks freed. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_draw_release_all).

Returns the .ehf layout with resource id from the layout table 0x0004251c (0xd records of 0x14 bytes {id, archive id, ehf member name, tmf member name or NULL, cache}, binary-searched with ui_find_resource_entry): on first use gets the archive (ui_load_duel_archive; 0 while it is not loaded), finds the .ehf member (container_ehp_find_member), caches it and, when a .tmf name is given and found, applies its flags (ui_ehf_apply_tmf_flags). Returns NULL for an unknown id or an archive not yet loaded. Side effects: writes the cache word; applies .tmf flags. Callers: 1 (0x00000994).

Returns the .gim texture with resource id from the texture table 0x000421bc (0x23 records of 0x10 bytes {id, archive id, member name, cache}): on first use loads/gets the archive (ui_load_duel_archive), finds the member (container_ehp_find_member) and caches it; NULL for an unknown id or an archive not yet loaded. Side effects: writes the cache word. Callers: 2 (ui_bind_card_art_texture, 0x00000994).

Gets a duel archive from the table 0x00041c0c (4 records of 0xcc bytes: +0 id, +4 default path stem, +0x34 + language * 4 per-language stems, +0xc4 buffer, +0xc8 loading flag): when the loading flag is clear returns the buffer if present; otherwise, on first use, builds the path from the stem of save_get_language() (or the default) plus the suffix at 0x00042620 (".ehp"), allocates its size (container_get_file_size(4, path)) from the module heap (system_duel_draw_heap_alloc/free copies 0x0002d1b4/0x0002d1c4), sets the loading flag and starts container_load_file(4, path, buffer, size, ui_on_duel_archive_loaded, record). Returns the buffer once loaded, otherwise 0 (also for an unknown id). Side effects: heap allocation, file load started, record words. Callers: 6 (ui_get_duel_layout, field_3d_dl_bind_fx_texture, 0x00000dac, ui_load_lp_panel_textures, ...).

Returns the large card art reader pointer 0x00b50098 (the cardh.cip reader opened by ui_create_card_art_readers). No side effects. Callers: 1 (0x00000994, which waits until card_db_cip_is_ready accepts it and passes it to ui_card_view_open).

Emits into the GE display list the texture of a card's small art: when card_id > 0 and the small art reader (0x00b5009c, cardm) has the card, writes the image texture for the artwork chosen in the save (save_get_card_value_bits4_6) with card_db_cip_write_image_texture; when card_id <= 0 or the art is not loaded yet, binds frame 0 of the placeholder texture 0x40002 (ui_get_duel_texture, field_3d_gim_emit_texture_frame0). Returns the advanced list pointer. Side effects: writes GE commands. Callers: 1 (field_3d_dl_bind_card_face_texture).

Recreates the two card art readers (ui_destroy_card_art_readers, ui_create_card_art_readers, which also clear the list) and fills the card art list 0x00b4ec90 (16-byte entries, count 0x00b50090) with an entry 0 and then every token card id in 0xe88-0x1f39 (card_db_is_token). Side effects: readers, list and count. Callers: 1 (0x00000994).

Returns the loaded field-spell backdrop archive for backdrop_id, or 0 while it is loading or after starting a load. Archive slots: 2 x 0x18 bytes at 0x00d420b0 (+0 id, +4 buffer, +8 in use, +0xc loaded, +0x10, +0x14 release pending), buffers of 0x80000 bytes at 0x00d420e0 + slot x 0x80000. When no slot holds the id, a free slot is claimed and container_load_file(3, "duel/bg/fmagic%04d.ehp" (format at 0x00042628) with the id, buffer, 0x80000, field_3d_on_backdrop_archive_loaded, slot) is started; when container_get_file_size reports no such file, id 0 (fmagic0000) is loaded instead. Side effects: claims an archive slot and starts an asynchronous file load. Callers: 1 (field_3d_dl_bind_fx_texture).

Prepares the cut-in loading slots for count characters (this module's variant of rel_duel_draw field_3d_setup_cutin_slots, without the smaller block of setup mode 2): allocates once a 0x483000-byte block with system_duel_draw_heap_alloc (0x0002d1b4) kept at 0x00e42194, resets the slot count 0x00e420e0 and fills one 0x2c-byte slot per entry at 0x00e420e4: +0 character, +4 variant, +0xc base-archive buffer at the block cursor (0x20c00 bytes reserved for generic characters (world_character_is_generic), else 0x4800); for characters other than 1, when no network session is active (system_get_net_active_flag), +8 cut-in archive buffer placed right after the base buffer and the cursor advanced by 0x17f800 in total. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap allocation, the slots and the slot count. Callers: 1 (0x00000d68).
